author: P. Fischer, 1857

familyName.es: Babosas con concha chupadoras de savia

note.en: A small green-algae-feeding slug with a thin shell on its back and a pair of flapping lobes, recorded on the Manzanillo shore in 2001 and 2002.
note.es: Una babosa pequeña que come algas verdes, con una concha delgada en el dorso y un par de lóbulos que se agitan, registrada en la orilla de Manzanillo en 2001 y 2002.

evidence: GBIF: 2 museum specimens, shore at Manzanillo, 2001 and 2002

sources.t: WoRMS / MolluscaBase: valid name and distribution

marks.en: Soft green slug with two large wing-like lobes along its sides.
marks.es: Babosa blanda y verde con dos grandes lóbulos laterales parecidos a alas.
